cnTitle: 紫微斗数看合同到期不续签：官禄宫被引动，先备补偿和求职窗口
enTitle: Zi Wei Dou Shu on a Fixed-Term Contract Not Renewed: Signs in the Career Palace
enDesc: A fixed-term contract not renewed often corresponds to the annual Career Palace being activated together with the Travel Palace, marking one stage ending before the next begins. It differs from mid-term dismissal, and compensation and the job-search timeline should be handled separately.
cnDesc: 劳动合同到期不续签，在盘上多对应流年官禄宫被引动、又逢迁移宫动，是“这一段结束、下一段还没接上”的象；它不同于中途被辞退，补偿和求职节奏要分开算。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看经济性裁员：官禄迁移同时引动，按整体裁撤应对
enTitle: Zi Wei Dou Shu on Economic Layoffs: When Career and Travel Activate Together
enDesc: Economic layoffs are a department or company-wide reduction, not personal, and often appear when the decade and annual Career and Travel Palaces are activated together. The key is recognizing the collective nature of the cut and arranging severance and re-employment.
cnDesc: 经济性裁员是部门或公司整体缩减，不是针对个人，盘上多表现为大限、流年官禄宫与迁移宫同时被引动；应对要点是认清“整体裁撤”的性质，把补偿和再就业安排好。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看违法辞退：官非象起，按证据和仲裁主张权益
enTitle: Zi Wei Dou Shu on Unlawful Dismissal: A Dispute Sign, Handled by Evidence and Arbitration
enDesc: Unlawful dismissal is termination without a legal basis, often shown in the chart by Tai Yang or Lian Zhen with Hua Ji, marking disputes and unstable authority. The chart only shows a tendency toward conflict; protecting your rights depends on evidence and labor arbitration, not on the chart.
cnDesc: 违法辞退是单位没有合法理由就解除合同，盘上多见太阳、廉贞化忌，主官非、权力不稳；但命理只显示“有争执”的倾向，能不能维权要靠证据和劳动仲裁，不能靠盘下结论。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看医疗期与病假工资：疾厄官禄并看，先治病再谈权益
enTitle: Zi Wei Dou Shu on the Medical Period and Sick Pay: Health and Career Together
enDesc: When illness requires stopping work, read the Health and Career Palaces together; the Health Palace shows health tendencies and the Career Palace the employment relationship during this time. You cannot be freely dismissed during the medical period, and sick pay has a minimum standard.
cnDesc: 生病需要停工治疗时，盘上要疾厄宫与官禄宫并看，疾厄宫显示健康倾向，官禄宫显示这段时间的劳动关系；医疗期内不能被随意辞退，病假工资也有最低口径。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看竞业限制补偿：官禄牵迁移财帛，按月对价要写清
enTitle: Zi Wei Dou Shu on Non-Compete Compensation: Career, Travel and Wealth
enDesc: A non-compete bars you from competitors for a period after leaving, often linking the Career Palace to the Travel and Wealth Palaces. It requires monthly economic compensation; without it, or with an excessive duration, the clause may not be enforceable.
cnDesc: 竞业限制是离职后一段时间不能去竞争对手处，盘上多是官禄宫牵连着迁移宫、财帛宫；它必须有按月支付的经济补偿，没有补偿或期限过长，条款的效力要打问号。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看劳务派遣权益：三方关系，合同社保同工同酬要核对
enTitle: Zi Wei Dou Shu on Labor-Dispatch Rights: A Three-Party Relationship
enDesc: Labor dispatch means you contract with the dispatch firm but work at the using company, corresponding to the Career and Friends Palaces being tied together. The key is recognizing the three-party relationship and verifying the labor contract, social insurance and equal pay, rather than accepting lower treatment as an outsider.
cnDesc: 劳务派遣是你与派遣公司签合同、却在用工单位干活，盘上对应官禄宫、交友宫同时牵扯；要点是认清三方关系，核对劳动合同、社保和同工同酬，不把自己当“外人”任人压低待遇。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看退休返聘：晚限官禄再动，劳务关系要签书面协议
enTitle: Zi Wei Dou Shu on Post-Retirement Re-Employment: The Late Career Reactivates
enDesc: Being re-employed after retirement often shows the late-limit Career Palace reactivating, marking someone who retires but does not stop. At this stage it is usually a service relationship rather than employment, so pay, duties and injury handling should be written into an agreement, not relying on the protections of active employment.
cnDesc: 退休后被返聘，盘上多是晚限官禄宫再度引动，主“退而不休”；但此时多为劳务关系而非劳动关系，报酬、工作内容和受伤处理要写进书面协议，不能照搬在职时的保障。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看试用期辞退：官禄初引动，录用条件与举证是关键
enTitle: Zi Wei Dou Shu on Probation Dismissal: Hiring Conditions and Proof
enDesc: Dismissal during probation shows the Career Palace being activated and then blocked at the start. The employer must prove you do not meet the hiring conditions, which must be clear in advance and backed by assessment; otherwise it may be unlawful termination.
cnDesc: 试用期被辞退，盘上是官禄宫刚开始引动就受阻；单位必须证明你“不符合录用条件”，且录用条件要事先明确、有考核依据，否则可能构成违法解除。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看失业金申领：非本人意愿中断，条件材料先备齐
enTitle: Zi Wei Dou Shu on Claiming Unemployment Benefits: Involuntary Loss
enDesc: Whether you can claim unemployment benefits depends mainly on involuntary loss of employment, at least one year of contributions and unemployment registration. The Career and Wealth blockage in the chart is only timing; eligibility and duration follow the social-insurance agency.
cnDesc: 失业后能否领失业金，关键看是否“非本人意愿中断就业”、缴费是否满一年、是否已做失业登记；盘上官禄、财帛受阻只是时机，能不能领、领多久，要按社保经办机构的口径准备。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看社保断缴：官禄变动留空档，补缴和影响要算清
enTitle: Zi Wei Dou Shu on Social-Insurance Gaps: Makeup Payments and Impact
enDesc: Social insurance can lapse during job changes or unemployment, shown by Career movement and Travel activation. A gap affects medical reimbursement, home-purchase eligibility and pension accumulation; whether and how to make it up follows the social-insurance authority.
cnDesc: 换工作、失业期间社保容易断缴，盘上是官禄宫变动、迁移宫引动；断缴会影响医保报销、购房资格和养老累计，能不能补缴、怎么补，要按社保部门规定处理。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看职称评审：官禄文昌并看，申报窗口要提前布局
enTitle: Zi Wei Dou Shu on Professional-Title Review: Career and Scholarly Stars
enDesc: Title review is read through the Career Palace and Wen Chang, Wen Qu, governing professional seniority and scholarly recognition. It has hard conditions on years, achievements, papers and timing; even when the chart shows a favorable stage, materials and the window must be prepared in advance.
cnDesc: 评职称看官禄宫与文昌、文曲，主专业资历和科名；它有年限、业绩、论文和申报时间的硬条件，盘上显示“利于申报”的阶段，也要把材料和窗口提前准备好。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看服务期与培训费：专项培训才有服务期，违约金以费用为限
enTitle: Zi Wei Dou Shu on the Service Period and Training Fees
enDesc: After an employer pays for specialized training, a service period may be agreed, corresponding to the Career and Wealth Palaces. Only specialized training supports a service period, and the penalty for early departure is limited to actual training costs and prorated by years served, not an arbitrary amount.
cnDesc: 单位出钱做专项培训后可约定服务期，盘上对应官禄宫、财帛宫；只有专项培训才能约定服务期，提前离职的违约金以实际培训费为限并按服务年限分摊，不能漫天要价。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看专项附加扣除：子女田宅父母疾厄，对宫核对别漏项
enTitle: Zi Wei Dou Shu on Special Additional Tax Deductions
enDesc: Special additional tax deductions correspond to children, education, housing, elder support and medical care, read through the Children, Property, Parents and Health Palaces. They are legal tax-reduction rights, filed according to actual circumstances, with no eligible item overlooked.
cnDesc: 个税专项附加扣除对应子女、教育、住房、赡养、医疗等事项，盘上要看子女宫、田宅宫、父母宫、疾厄宫；它是法定的减税权益，按实际情况填报，符合条件的项目一项都别漏。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看个税汇算：财帛宫年终引动，退补都要按时办
enTitle: Zi Wei Dou Shu on the Annual Tax Reconciliation: Refunds and Payments
enDesc: The annual reconciliation recalculates the year income and deductions, refunding overpayments and collecting underpayments, corresponding to the Wealth Palace activated early in the year. A refund returns your overpaid money and a payment settles what is owed, both due within the period, with possible late fees.
cnDesc: 年度个税汇算是把全年收入、扣除重新算一遍，多退少补，盘上对应财帛宫在年初被引动；退税是退回自己多缴的钱，补税是补缴少缴的部分，都要在规定时间内办理，逾期可能有滞纳金。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看提前还款：财帛田宅并看，划算与否取决于利率和现金流
enTitle: Zi Wei Dou Shu on Early Repayment: It Depends on Rate and Cash Flow
enDesc: Whether to repay a mortgage early is read through the Wealth and Property Palaces; Wealth shows cash flow and the cost of money, Property the home. It is not only paying less interest; compare investment returns, keep emergency funds and check penalties, rather than following the crowd.
cnDesc: 提前还贷要不要做，盘上要财帛宫、田宅宫并看，财帛宫看现金流和资金成本，田宅宫看房产；它不只是“少付利息”，还要比较投资回报、预留应急资金和违约金，不能盲目跟风。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看期权股权：官禄财帛交友，归属行权和退出要算清
enTitle: Zi Wei Dou Shu on Stock Options and Equity: Vesting, Exercise and Exit
enDesc: Company options and equity correspond to the Career, Wealth and Friends Palaces, governing career, long-term gains and partnership. They carry vesting, an exercise price and exit conditions, and their value depends on company growth and the agreement, not just the number of shares.
cnDesc: 公司给的期权、股权，盘上对应官禄宫、财帛宫和交友宫，主事业与长期收益、合伙关系；它有归属期、行权价和退出条件，值不值钱取决于公司发展和协议条款，不能只看“给了多少股”。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看抚养费：子女宫财帛宫并看，按实际需要和收入协商
enTitle: Zi Wei Dou Shu on Child Support: Children and Wealth Palaces
enDesc: The parent not raising the child pays support, read through the Children and Wealth Palaces. It is set by the child actual needs, each parent ability and the local living standard, first by agreement and otherwise by court, not at will.
cnDesc: 不直接抚养子女的一方要付抚养费，盘上要看子女宫、财帛宫；抚养费按子女实际需要、父母负担能力和当地生活水平确定，先协商、协商不成由法院判，不能想给多少给多少。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看遗赠与继承：父母田宅财帛，期限和顺序要分清
enTitle: Zi Wei Dou Shu on Legacy vs Inheritance: Timing and Order
enDesc: Inheritance passes to statutory heirs in order, while a legacy leaves property to someone outside the statutory heirs, read through the Parents, Property and Wealth Palaces. The key difference is that a legacy must be accepted within two months of knowing; silence is treated as refusal.
cnDesc: 继承是法定继承人按顺序承接遗产，遗赠是把财产留给法定继承人以外的人，盘上看父母宫、田宅宫、财帛宫；关键区别是遗赠要在知道后两个月内表示接受，到期没表示视为放弃。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看监护权：子女父母田宅并看，以最有利于孩子为原则
enTitle: Zi Wei Dou Shu on Guardianship: The Best Interests of the Child
enDesc: Who directly raises and guards the child after divorce is read through the Children, Parents and Property Palaces. The core is the best interests of the child, considering age, care, finances and a stable environment, first by agreement and otherwise by court.
cnDesc: 离婚后孩子由谁直接抚养、监护，盘上看子女宫、父母宫、田宅宫；确定的核心是“最有利于未成年子女”，要看年龄、陪伴、经济和稳定环境，先协商，协商不成由法院判。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看收养：子女宫父母宫并看，条件和登记是关键
enTitle: Zi Wei Dou Shu on Adoption: Conditions and Registration
enDesc: Adopting a child is read through the Children and Parents Palaces. Adoption has strict conditions and procedures; both adopter and child must qualify, and adoption must be registered, with the relationship established from registration, not by private agreement.
cnDesc: 收养孩子，盘上看子女宫、父母宫；收养有严格的条件和程序，收养人和被收养人都要符合规定，且必须办理收养登记，关系自登记之日起成立，不能只靠私下约定。
